I saved the animation to `neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html`, a single 507-line HTML file. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't checked how it looks or how smoothly it runs.

- **Libraries:** the only external script is dat.gui 0.7.9, loaded from cdnjs. Everything else is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It uses no images, textures or other outside files.
- **Canvas and colours:** one 800×800 canvas is centred on a `#05070f` background, and it uses the neon palette you listed. The glow comes from canvas `shadowBlur`, with a faint vignette and scanlines added on top.
- **Growth:** 3–6 seed neurons start near the centre and grow curved, branching lines step by step. Branch thickness varies a little and smaller side branches appear now and then. Depth and total branch count are capped, and growth stops once the network reaches a stable size.
- **Synapses and pulses:** when two branch tips come close, they form a synapse, and duplicates between the same branches are prevented. Synapses glow and pulse over time, and sparks keep travelling along random connections after growth ends.
- **Controls:** the dat.gui panel has Growth, Synapses, Pulses and Visuals folders with every control you listed. It also has buttons to regenerate the network, clear the canvas and pause/resume.
- **Code structure:** the script is split into setup, GUI, growth, synapse detection, pulses and rendering, with short comments on each section.

Requirements:
- Use one 800×800 <canvas> centered on a dark background.
- Allowed external library: dat.gui for parameter controls.
- No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, or assets.
- Everything must be inside a single HTML file.

- Use this exact neon palette:
  - Background: #05070f
  - Background glow: #101a3a
  - Main branch color: #00e5ff
  - Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
  - Synapse color: #ff2bd6
  - Pulse color: #fff36a
  - UI/accent color: #ffd400
  - Optional dark grid/scanline color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)

- Use canvas shadowBlur for neon glow effects.
- Do not use images or textures.
- Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style in the generated code or comments.

Do not mention any game/movie/brand/copyrighted style in code or comments.

Palette: bg #05070f, bg glow #101a3a (radial gradient center), branch #00e5ff, accent branch #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI accent #ffd400 (style dat.gui text/sliders/title with it via CSS), scanlines rgba(0,229,255,0.08).

Code sections with short comments: setup, GUI setup, neuron growth, synapse detection, pulse animation, rendering.

params: neuronCount 4 (3-6 step1), growthSpeed 1 (0.2-4), maxDepth 5 (1-8), splitChance 0.03 (0-0.15), curvature 0.25 (0-1), maxLength 90 (20-200), synapseDist 14 (4-40), synapseGlow 18 (0-40), pulseSpeed 0.02 (0.005-0.08), pulseFreq 0.08 (0-0.5 spawn prob per frame), pulseBright 1 (0.2-2), colors bg, branch, accent, synapse, pulse. Buttons: regenerate(), clear() (empties network arrays and pulses), togglePause(). dat.gui folders Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals (colors in Visuals; buttons at root). Regenerate on neuronCount change.

Data: neurons [{x,y,id}], branches [{id, neuron, parent, depth, pts:[{x,y}], angle, len, maxLen, width, accent:bool, growing:true, turn}]. MAX_BRANCHES=400. Seeds: neuronCount neurons within 120px of center; each spawns 3-5 root branches at spread angles.
Growth each frame (if not paused): for each growing branch, advance growthSpeed steps of ~2px: angle += turn + (rand-0.5)*curvature*0.5, turn smoothed (turn = turn*0.9 + (rand-0.5)*curvature*0.05); push point; stop if len>=maxLen or out of bounds (margin 20). Random side branch with splitChance if depth<maxDepth and count<MAX (smaller maxLen*0.6, thinner width, 30% accent). At end fork into 2 children if depth<maxDepth. growth done when no growing branches -> stable.
Synapse detection: for growing tips, compare with tips/points of branches from other neurons (check last point of other branches and sample every 4th point cheaply); if dist<synapseDist and key `min-max` of branch ids not in Set, create synapse {a:branchA,b:branchB,x,y,phase}. Also create a link between neurons for pulses. Limit synapses 150.
Pulses: pulses [{path:[points], t, speed}]. Spawn with pulseFreq probability: pick random synapse, build path = reversed points of branch a from its root (concatenate ancestor points from neuron to synapse via parent chain) then synapse to b's chain back to b's neuron — simpler: path = chainPoints(a) up to nearest index to synapse, then reverse chainPoints(b) to root. If no synapses, pulse along random branch chain. Move t += pulseSpeed*growthless; position interpolated along path by cumulative index with lerp. Draw spark: bright core with shadowBlur, short trail of 6 prior positions fading, small jitter lines. Remove when t>=1; on arrival flash the synapse (flash value decays).
Rendering: fill bg, radial glow gradient, draw branches with quadratic curves through midpoints (ctx.quadraticCurveTo), lineWidth=width, shadowBlur 8, color branch or accent, globalAlpha ~0.85. Neuron somas as glowing circles. Synapses: circles radius 3+sin pulse, shadowBlur synapseGlow*(1+flash), brighter. Pulses with pulse color * pulseBright alpha. Then scanlines (every 3px, offset animated), sparse random noise pixels (~150 small rects per frame low alpha), vignette radial gradient to rgba(0,0,0,0.7). Reset shadowBlur after. requestAnimationFrame loop; when paused still render but skip updates. Show small status text in corner in #ffd400 (branches/synapses/state GROWING/STABLE) in monospace."}
